objs = {
'3a':(3,[(1,2),(1,3)]),
'6a':(6,[(1,7),(2,7)]),
'7':(7,[(2,5),(3,5)]),
'8':(8,[(3,1),(3,2)]),
'6b':(6,[(4,8),(4,9)]),
'3b':(3,[(5,4),(5,5)]),
'9':(9,[(6,2),(7,2)]),
'4':(4,[(6,8),(7,8)]),
'3c':(3,[(8,0),(9,0)]),
'1':(1,[(8,5),(8,6)]),
'5':(5,[(9,7),(9,8)]),
}
steps=0
while True:
    occ={p:k for k,(_,cells) in objs.items() for p in cells}
    can=set(objs)
    # eliminate objects whose upward target hits barrier or an object that cannot move
    changed=True
    while changed:
        changed=False
        for k in list(can):
            _,cells=objs[k]
            for r,c in cells:
                target=(r-1,c)
                if r-1 < 1 or (target in occ and occ[target] != k and occ[target] not in can):
                    can.remove(k); changed=True; break
    if not can: break
    for k in can:
        col,cells=objs[k]
        objs[k]=(col,[(r-1,c) for r,c in cells])
    steps+=1
    if steps>20: break
print('steps',steps)
for k,v in objs.items(): print(k,v)
grid=[[0]*10 for _ in range(10)]
for col,cells in objs.values():
    for r,c in cells:grid[r][c]=col
grid[0]=[2]*10
print(grid)
